mapper.select: SELECT name FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ic.id AS invitation_code_id, ic.common_survey_id, cs.member_id AS inviter_id, ic.status FROM invitation_code ic INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE ic.code_value = #{inviteCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM member WHERE id IN (#{firstMemberId}, #{secondMemberId}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE ic FROM invitation_code ic INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId}
DELETE psie FROM personal_survey_investment_experience psie INNER JOIN personal_survey ps ON ps.id = psie.personal_survey_id WHERE ps.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET investment_type = NULL WHERE id = #{memberId} AND investment_type IS NOT NULL
UPDATE invitation_code SET status = 'USED' WHERE id = #{invitationCodeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
